It has been said: the front and back ordering is because what is meant by worship is carrying out all the commands, such as guidance, conveying the message, and other things, and what is meant by trust is trusting Him in that. It is as if it were said: carry out what you have been commanded, persist in the call and the conveying, and trust Him in that, and do not care about those who do not believe, and let not your chest be constricted by them. ﴿And your Lord is not unaware of what you do﴾ with the second-person *ta'* (you), giving precedence to the addressee. Nafi', Abu 'Amir, Hafs, Qatadah, al-A'raj, Shaybah, Abu Ja'far, and al-Jahdari read it this way. That is, your Lord is not unaware of what you do, and what they do, so He will recompense each of you, you and them, according to what is deserved. The rest of the Seven read it with *ya'* (third person), which is clear. This is all. In *Zawa'id al-Zuhd* by 'Abd Allah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal and *Fada'il al-Qur'an* by Ibn al-Duraysi, from Ka'b, it is reported that the opening of the Torah is the opening of al-An'am, and its closing is the closing of Hud: ﴿And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth﴾ to the end of the surah. And Allah knows best.

* * *

**(From the door of allusion in the verses)** ﴿On the Day it comes, no soul will speak except by His permission. Among them will be the wretched and the happy﴾: the wretched being completely wretched, and the happy being completely happy. ﴿As for those who were wretched, they will be in the Fire﴾, that is, the fire of being deprived of what is desired, and the pains of the sins they earned, which is the torment of the soul. ﴿Abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord wills﴾, so they pass from that to what is even more severe, from the fires of the heart, which is through wrath and humiliation, and the fires of the spirit, which is through veiling, cursing, and subjugation. ﴿Indeed your Lord is the Accomplisher of what He intends﴾, with no restraint upon Him, glorified is He. ﴿As for those who were made happy, they will be in the Garden﴾, that is, the Garden of attaining desires and pleasures, which is the Garden of the soul, ﴿abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord wills﴾, so they pass from that to what is higher and higher, from the gardens of the heart in the station of the manifestations of the attributes, and the gardens of the spirit in the station of witnessing. There is "what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart has conceived." It may be that the tanwin (indefiniteness) is taken to indicate kind, and the exception is interpreted as the wretched one's exit from the Fire by ascending from his station to the Garden through the purification of his soul from what came between him and it. ﴿So be upright as you have been commanded﴾, that is, in establishing the rights of the Truth and of creation, by safeguarding His rights, may He be exalted, honoring His command, and guiding His creation, along with witnessing multiplicity in unity and unity in multiplicity, without violating any condition of honoring. ﴿And whoever has repented﴾ from his selfhood and the sin of his existence along with you, from the believers who affirm His oneness, to the station of subsistence after annihilation. It has been said: the uprightness commanded to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace (ﷺ), is above the uprightness commanded to those with him, peace be upon him. The conjunction does not require more than sharing in the act in general, as His saying, exalted is He, indicates: ﴿Allah bears witness that there is no deity except Him, and the angels and those of knowledge﴾, according to one opinion. From here al-Junayd, may Allah sanctify his secret, said: uprightness with fear and hope is the state of the worshippers; uprightness with awe and hope is the state of those brought near; and uprightness with absence from seeing one's own uprightness is the state of the knowers. ﴿And do not transgress﴾, do not go beyond what the Sharia has set as limits for you, for going beyond it is heresy. (And do not incline) meaning do not lean even the slightest lean ﴿toward those who wronged﴾, and they are the dark souls inclined toward evils by their original nature, as it has been said:

*Injustice is among the dispositions of souls; if you find one who is chaste, it is for a reason that he did not wrong.*

This has been narrated from 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father, from Ja'far, may Allah be pleased with them. It has been said: the meaning is do not follow the hypocrites, the ignorant, and evil companions. It has been said: do not keep company with the wicked, and do not sit with the people of innovation. ﴿And establish the prayer at the two ends of the day and in the first hours of the night﴾: a command to establish the obligatory prayer as you know it. They have mentioned that prayer is the ascension of the believer, and in the reports there is what indicates its high status. The matter needs no explanation. ﴿Indeed, good deeds remove bad deeds﴾. Al-Wasiti said: the lights of acts of obedience remove the darkness of sins.

Yahya ibn Mu'adh said: Allah, glorified is He, was not pleased for the believer to have sin until He covered it; and He was not pleased with the covering until He forgave; and He was not pleased with forgiveness until He replaced it. So He, glorified is He, said: ﴿Indeed, good deeds remove bad deeds﴾, and He, exalted is He, said: ﴿Those, Allah will replace their bad deeds with good deeds﴾. That which was mentioned, of establishing the prayer at the indicated times and the removal of bad deeds by good deeds, is a reminder for those who remember: a reminder for one who recalls his state when present with Allah, exalted is He, in clarity, collectedness, intimacy, and taste. ﴿And be patient﴾ with Allah, glorified is He, in uprightness, and with Allah, exalted is He, by presence in prayer and not inclining to other than Him. ﴿Indeed Allah does not waste the reward of the doers of good﴾, those who witness Him while upholding the rights. ﴿Why were there not, among the generations before you, people of remnant who forbade corruption on the earth?﴾ In this is encouragement to enjoin good and forbid evil. ﴿And your Lord would never destroy the towns unjustly while their people were reforming﴾. It has been said: "the towns" here is an allusion to the hearts, and "their people" is an allusion to the faculties. ﴿And if your Lord had willed, He would have made mankind one community﴾, equal in readiness and united upon the religion of tawhid. ﴿And they will continue to differ﴾ in direction and readiness. ﴿Except those upon whom your Lord has mercy﴾, by His guidance to tawhid and His granting success to perfection, for they agree in doctrine and aim, and are in accord in conduct and path; their qibla is the Truth, their religion is tawhid and love, even if their expressions differ, as it has been said:

*Our expressions are many, but your beauty is one, and each points toward that beauty.*

﴿And for that﴾ difference ﴿He created them﴾, so that they would be manifestations of His beauty, majesty, gentleness, and subjugation. It has been said: so that the order of the world would be completed and the sustenance of the life of this world would be established. ﴿And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled﴾, meaning it has been firmly decreed and settled: ﴿"I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."﴾ Because Hell is a rank among the ranks of existence, and it is not permissible in wisdom to leave it idle or to keep it in the concealment of non-existence while it is possible. ﴿And all [of] the stories of the messengers We relate to you are that by which We make firm your heart﴾, because of what they contained of their enduring hardships from their peoples, along with their steadfastness and patience, and the destruction of their enemies. ﴿And there has come to you in this﴾ surah (the Truth), from which one should not turn aside, ﴿and an admonition and a reminder for the believers﴾. The singling out of this surah for mention is as we have pointed out. It has been said: it is for honor; otherwise the whole Qur'an is like that, and all draw from its sea according to what suits their drinking-place. From here it was said: the common people cling to its outward meaning, the elite are bewildered by its inner meaning, and the elite of the elite are absorbed in the manifestation of the Truth, glorified is He, within it. ﴿And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens﴾, according to the variety of its meanings, ﴿and the earth﴾ likewise, ﴿and to Him the whole matter is returned﴾, that is, every affair of affairs, for all of it is from Him. ﴿So worship Him﴾: drop from yourself the portions of your soul and stand with the command under the condition of courtesy. ﴿And put your trust in Him﴾: do not be concerned with what you have already been sufficed, and be concerned with what you have been called to. ﴿And your Lord is not unaware of what you do﴾, so He will recompense each according to what wisdom requires. Allah, exalted is He, is the Master of success, and in His hand are the reins of realization. There is no lord other than Him, and none is hoped for except His good.

This is the end of what we were granted of the interpretation of Surah Hud, by the favor of Him in whose hand is generosity and bounty. We ask Him, glorified is He, to make easy for us the completion of what we intended, and to grant us success in understanding the meanings of His speech in what He loves and is pleased with. Praise be to Allah as He deserves, and blessings and peace be upon the one after whom there is no prophet, and upon his family, companions, army, and party, for as long as pens wander in the gardens of writing, and understandings come forth from the reservoirs of tafsir.
